_note: Evidence cards for the Stances page's 'big questions'. Each item points one way: 'pro' or 'con' (labels per card). Roll items: 'yea' says which side a Yea vote is on; his vote, and therefore the item's side, comes from data/votes.json. Release items: 'stmt' must match one release. Headlines are computed in scripts/build_cards.py by the rule stated on each card. Money placeholders: {corpCur} {ncorpCur} {corpPrev} {tradeCur} {laborCur} (latest and previous FEC cycle) or per cycle, e.g. {corp26}. Build: python3 -I scripts/build_cards.py (after build_stances.py and build_establishment.py).

items.t: Secured $1.03 million for LAPD’s West Los Angeles and Pacific divisions to stand up real-time crime centers and expand their sensor networks.
Cosponsored the National Police Week resolutions in 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026.
Cosponsored the Officer John Barnes and Chief Michael Ansbro Public Safety Officers’ Benefit Program Expansion Act of 2026.
Cosponsored the Promoting Police Leadership Act.
Cosponsored the Reauthorizing Support and Treatment for Officers in Crisis Act of 2024.
Cosponsored a bill letting COPS grants pay for police recruits to attend academies if they agree to serve in their own communities.

Cosponsored the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2024, which bans no-knock warrants in drug cases, pushes states to ban chokeholds, and includes the Stop Militarizing Law Enforcement Act, restricting the Pentagon’s transfers of surplus military equipment to police.
Sponsored the Accountability for Federal Law Enforcement Act (2021, reintroduced 2025), giving people abused by federal law enforcement the right to sue.
Sponsored the PEACE Act, written with Rep. Ro Khanna, to limit federal officers’ use of lethal force.
Cosponsored the Police Training and Independent Review Act in 2021, 2024 and 2026.
Cosponsored the Bivens Act in 2021, 2024 and 2025.
Cosponsored a bill funding mental-health professionals to respond instead of police in emergencies involving people with mental illness or developmental disabilities.
Cosponsored the Military in Law Enforcement Accountability Act.
